notes.title: Improvements update
notes.content:
Today we have released a new build with improvement such as:

[list]
[*]  New Tutorial Level
[*]  "A Great Escape" level is now battle exclusive instead of Tutorial
[*]  New enemies and HP added to "A Great Escape"
[*]  Improved Environment Lights Effects
[*]  Removing the sliding movement on "A Great Escape"
[*]  Added activation of Protocolos of shooting, shields, jetpack, and bullet-time using collectibles
[*]  New sensitivity system for gamepad
[*]  Minor bugs fixing
[/list]

notes.title: Fixing bugs, improving performance, and small extra for SpeedRunners!
notes.content:
After more than 10,000 gamers in less than three weeks, you showed us that we're on the right track. Thanks for your amazing support.

For this event, we'll release a new version of the Two Demo Levels you already love including:
[list]
[*]Correcting Typos on the dialogues
[*]Changing keyboard movement to WASD and Up, Down, Left, and Right so you can pick your favorite
[*]Changing features to be controlled on IJKL keyboard buttons.
[*]Red CB-Trooper has a new feature you'll discover
[*]Fixing error on the end of the Tutorial Level
[*]Added a credit's section
[/list]

And beyond the previously mentioned fixings, and after seeing a lot of streamers challenging each other on [url=https://twitter.com/wulumgames]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://discord.gg/TaAVqT9paB]Discord[/url], we're adding a timer they can use to brag about their record. We know you all will enjoy it.

A quick video about this new update:
[previewyoutube=2HYiUykXv2w;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]
